body:
Alex Martinez: Heads up — draft internal announcement for the new Quickstart Templates initiative (RAG + agents). Would love eyes on wording + where we should share.

---
DRAFT (v0)

:mega: New: Redwood Quickstart Templates (RAG + Agents) — production-shaped examples

We’re investing in a set of opinionated Quickstart Templates to help developers go from “API key” -> a working, observable app fast (target <15 min), without teaching unsafe patterns.

What we’re building (v1 catalog):
• RAG service + ingestion pipeline (Python + TypeScript)
• Agent-style orchestration w/ tool calling (Python + TypeScript)
• Combined RAG+agent workflow (retrieval as a tool)

What’s different vs typical sample apps:
• Safe defaults: timeouts, retries/backoff, rate-limit handling, secrets hygiene, prompt/tool safety guardrails, PII logging guidance
• Observability out of the box: OpenTelemetry traces + structured logs + metrics (request_id / tenant correlation, token/cost + latency breakdowns, error taxonomy)
• Clear path from Hosted -> Dedicated/Private (config + deployment notes, not a framework)

How you can help:
1) Try the templates once we post the first preview branch and tell us where you got stuck
2) React/Reply with “I can dogfood” if you can run one template end-to-end this week
3) Share feedback in #devex (preferred) or DM @Talia Benson if you have sensitive/security notes

Owners:
DX: @Talia Benson (program), @Elliot Price (docs), @Monica Patel (SDK)
Product partners: @Nikhil Sharma (Hosted API), Console/telemetry: @Logan Wright

More details: (Confluence link) https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/quickstarts
Repo placeholder: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-quickstarts (coming)
---

Questions:
• Which channels should we cross-post to for the right audience? (#eng, #product, #support, #customer-success?)
• Any must-include callouts (esp. around rate limits + streaming reliability) before we send?

Talia Benson: +1. Suggest we include a clear “feedback channel + what to include” so we get actionable reports.

Maybe add:
• include your OS/language/runtime + template name
• copy/paste the “run id” / request_id from logs
• mention Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private context

Elliot Price: Wording looks good. Can we avoid “coming” links in an announcement? People will click and then complain.

Proposal: replace repo placeholder w/ “watch this thread” and we’ll follow up w/ a second message once the repo is public.

Monica Patel: +1 on the callout for rate limits + retries. We should explicitly say “templates handle 429s with backoff; don’t disable retries unless you know why.”

Also can we add a note: “SDK helper used in templates is the recommended pattern; please don’t copy older snippets from random gists.”

Nikhil Sharma: Add a sentence that this aligns with Hosted API + Console: request_id echo + traceparent passthrough, token-level cost breakdowns, route/model tags. That will help product folks understand why we’re doing it.

Logan Wright: For telemetry: we should say “conforms to Telemetry Contract v1” (and link it) so teams don’t reinvent metric names.

Also important: remind folks not to add high-cardinality attributes (full prompts, user IDs). Otherwise we’ll get a flood of ‘why is my bill huge’ later.

Sean Gallagher: Suggest we add a short “SRE-friendly” line: health checks, graceful shutdown, default timeouts, and non-noisy alerts. People in #eng-sre will care.

Also: if we cross-post to #eng, keep it shorter. They won’t read a wall.

Renee Sullivan: If we’re cross-posting, I’d do:
• #eng (short)
• #devex (full)
• #support (call out what’s changing + where to route template questions)

And ask for volunteers for a 20-min usability test run. I can coordinate a few sessions.

Sahana Iyer: +1 on avoiding dead links. Also add: “CI will run smoke tests; if you see flakes, post in #devex with the job URL.”

Slackbot: Reminder: Company announcements should avoid posting customer names or confidential URLs. If you need to share sensitive details, use the internal doc link or DM.

Alex Martinez: This is super helpful.

Edits I’ll make:
• Remove repo placeholder link; follow up when live
• Add a “how to give feedback” block (template name, request_id, Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
• Add telemetry contract v1 + cardinality reminder
• Add explicit 429/streaming reliability note

Cross-post plan:
• Post full version here + #devex
• Post a shortened version to #eng and #support with “reply in #devex”

If anyone has a strong objection, reply today. Otherwise I’ll send tomorrow AM PT.
